## apiome repos {#repos}

List tenant Git repositories and inspect repository files.

```text
apiome repos [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`add`](#repos-add), [`content`](#repos-content), [`files`](#repos-files), [`import`](#repos-import), [`imports`](#repos-imports), [`inspect`](#repos-inspect), [`list`](#repos-list), [`scan`](#repos-scan), [`show`](#repos-show), [`verify`](#repos-verify).

## apiome repos add {#repos-add}

Register a tenant repository (not exposed on /v1 REST).

```text
apiome repos add [OPTIONS]
```

## apiome repos content {#repos-content}

Fetch repository file bytes (GET …/files/{file_id}/content).

```text
apiome repos content [OPTIONS] REPOSITORY_ID FILE_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `REPOSITORY_ID` | text | yes | Repository UUID. |
| `FILE_ID` | text | yes | Repository file UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `-` |  | Destination file path, or - for stdout. |

## apiome repos files {#repos-files}

List repository files (GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_slug}/repositories/{id}/files).

```text
apiome repos files [OPTIONS] REPOSITORY_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `REPOSITORY_ID` | text | yes | Repository UUID whose files to list. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--glob` | text |  |  | Comma-separated glob patterns on repository-relative paths. |
| `--regex` | text |  |  | POSIX regular expression on repository-relative paths. |
| `--preset` | text |  |  | Files-tab preset filter. |
| `--detected-kind` | text |  |  | Exact match on detected_kind. |
| `--importable` / `--not-importable` | flag | `--not-importable` |  | Filter by importable verdict. |
| `--format` | text |  |  | Output format: table (default) or json. |

## apiome repos list {#repos-list}

List tenant repositories (GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_slug}/repositories).

```text

```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--provider` | text |  |  | Filter by Git provider: github, gitlab, bitbucket, or public_url. |
| `--status` | text |  |  | Filter by lifecycle status: pending, scanning, ready, error, or archived. |
| `--name` | text |  |  | Case-insensitive substring match on repository display name. |
| `--format` | text |  |  | Output format: table (default) or json. |
